[RLOW.5.6.5.5] **Bindings.** A sequence binds every named variable of
every pattern in it, and each is in scope as any pattern binding is
([LGRA.8.6]): in every later step's `where`, the trailing one included, and on
the RHS. Each step's ordering predicate is strict, `Y.ts > X.ts` and never
`>=` ([LTHE.5.2]).
